title: CSLib — Lean Computer Science Library
summary: An upstream Lean library formalizing computer science theories and tools, with reusable APIs for software verification and certified software.
assumptions: Each development has its own formal definitions and hypotheses; inspect those before reuse.
limitations: The commons has not independently built or semantically audited this pinned CSLib revision.
Project registration makes no universal correctness claim about its contents.
reuse: Follow upstream's dependency and toolchain instructions using the pinned commit; review each formal statement before use.

opportunities: Use upstream contribution guidance to find suitable work.
Discuss reusable computer science formalizations with upstream maintainers.
